title: Wire biometric login to the auth service
description: Hook Face ID and fingerprint unlock into the existing token exchange, with a PIN fallback when the device has no enrolled biometrics.

title: Instant payment confirmation screen
description: Build the success state shown after a payment clears, including the share-receipt action and the retry path for timeouts.

title: Fix duplicate transactions in the spending feed
description: Pending and settled versions of the same transaction both render. De-duplicate on the reference number and prefer the settled record.

title: Accessibility audit of the transfer flow
description: Screen-reader pass over all five transfer steps, checking focus order, labels and contrast against WCAG 2.2 AA.

title: Beta release notes and store listing
description: Draft the public beta notes, refresh the store screenshots and get the copy signed off by the client's compliance team.

title: Penetration test remediation
description: Close the three medium findings from the external pen test: certificate pinning, clipboard scrubbing and session timeout handling.

title: Offline mode for the account summary
description: Cache the last successful balance response so the summary card still renders when the device drops connectivity.

title: Regression suite for the payments module
description: Automate the twenty-two manual payment scenarios currently run by hand before every release.

title: Migrate case studies into the headless CMS
description: Move all thirty-one case studies across, map the legacy fields to the new schema and set up redirects from the old URLs.

title: Homepage hero animation
description: Implement the scroll-linked hero animation from the approved motion spec, with a reduced-motion variant.

title: Cut the largest contentful paint below 2s
description: The hero image and the web font are both blocking. Preload the font subset and serve the hero as AVIF with a responsive srcset.

title: Design the sustainability report template
description: A reusable long-form layout for the annual sustainability report, with pull quotes, data callouts and a downloadable summary.

title: Cookie consent and analytics wiring
description: Add a consent banner that gates analytics until the visitor opts in, defaulting every non-essential category to off.

title: Content freeze and final copy review
description: Lock the copy deck, run it past legal and hand the final version to the client for sign-off before launch.

title: Set up the staging environment
description: Preview deployments per pull request, seeded with a sanitised copy of the production content.

title: Schema mapping document
description: Map every legacy table and column to its target equivalent, flagging the fourteen columns with no clean destination.

title: Dual-write adapter
description: Write to both the legacy database and the new platform during the cut-over window, with a reconciliation job comparing the two nightly.

title: Load test the new warehouse
description: Replay a month of production query traffic against the new platform and record the p95 latency per query class.

title: Roll-back runbook
description: Document the exact steps to fall back to the legacy database, including the data window that would be lost at each stage.

title: Client sign-off on the migration window
description: Agree the eight-hour maintenance window with Orion operations and confirm it clears their month-end processing.

title: Ticket tracking timeline
description: A per-ticket activity timeline showing every status change, agent note and customer reply in one thread.

title: Knowledge base search
description: Typo-tolerant search across all published articles with keyboard navigation of the results.

title: Live chat hand-off
description: Escalate a self-service session to a human agent, carrying the full context of what the customer already tried.

title: Full accessibility sweep
description: WCAG 2.2 AA audit across the whole portal, with fixes for the nine issues raised.

title: Hand-over documentation
description: Architecture notes, deployment guide and support runbook handed to the Vega internal team.

title: Colour and spacing token set
description: Define the full token scale, including the dark theme mapping, and publish it as both CSS variables and a JSON export.

title: Form primitives
description: Input, select, checkbox, radio and field-error components, all with proper labelling and error announcement.

title: Data table component
description: Sortable, paginated table with a sticky header, a column-visibility menu and a sensible mobile fallback.

title: Storybook documentation pass
description: Usage guidance, do/don't examples and prop tables for every component that has shipped so far.

title: Publish v1.0 to the internal registry
description: Cut the first stable release, write the changelog and announce the migration path off the old shared styles package.

title: Dark theme audit across products
description: Check every consuming product against the dark token mapping and log the contrast failures.

title: Map the existing eleven-screen flow
description: Session recordings and drop-off analysis for each step of the current onboarding journey.

title: Progressive document capture
description: Let patients upload identity documents later without losing their place in the flow.

title: Four-screen flow build
description: Implement the condensed journey behind a feature flag and run it as a 50/50 experiment.

title: Experiment read-out and roll-out
description: Completion rate rose from 61% to 84%. Ramp the new flow to 100% and retire the old screens.
